# Archive of European Integration

> > Digital repository of European Union documents, Commission publications, and research materials maintained by the University of Pittsburgh, covering EU integration history, enlargement, and policy development.

The Archive of European Integration (AEI) is a comprehensive digital archive hosted by the University of Pittsburgh that preserves historical EU Commission documents, PHARE Programme materials, policy papers, and publications spanning from the 1960s through the 2000s. The archive serves as a crucial resource for researchers studying European integration, EU enlargement to Central and Eastern Europe, and the development of EU policies including the information society, single market, and regional development.

## Key Topics

- European Union integration
- EU Commission documents and publications
- PHARE Programme (Poland and Hungary: Assistance for Restructuring their Economies)
- EU enlargement to Central and Eastern Europe
- European Commission working documents
- Information society development
- Single market development
- Regional development and financial assistance
- XIII Magazine and EU information services
- ISPA and SAPARD programmes
- European Communities historical records
- EU treaty reform and intergovernmental conferences
- Third country agreements
- Western European Union
- European statistical policy (SIGMA, CEIES)

## Archive Overview

- [Welcome to Archive of European Integration](https://aei.pitt.edu): Homepage for AEI digital archive of EU documents and research papers

## EU Enlargement and PHARE Programme

- [PHARE Hungary 1993 Indicative Programme Summary](https://aei.pitt.edu/100047): 1993 PHARE Programme indicative summary for Hungary enlargement
- [PHARE Latvia 1993 Indicative Programme Summary](https://aei.pitt.edu/100048): 1993 PHARE Programme indicative summary for Latvia enlargement
- [PHARE Lithuania 1993 Indicative Programme Summary](https://aei.pitt.edu/100049): 1993 PHARE Programme indicative summary for Lithuania enlargement
- [PHARE Poland 1993 Indicative Programme Summary](https://aei.pitt.edu/100050): 1993 PHARE Programme indicative summary for Poland enlargement
- [Phare Programme and Contract Information, 1995 Latvia](https://aei.pitt.edu/100038): 1995 Phare Programme financial assistance contract info for Latvia
- [Phare Programme and Contract Information, 1995 Lithuania](https://aei.pitt.edu/100039): 1995 Phare Programme financial assistance contract info for Lithuania
- [PHARE Operational programmes 1994 Update n°6](https://aei.pitt.edu/100056): 1994 PHARE operational programmes update for Central-Eastern Europe

## Single Market and Economic Integration

- [Information Pack on the Large Market - Part One: The general picture, 1987](https://aei.pitt.edu/100009): 1987 EU Commission working document on single market development
- [ECSC Regional Development - $30 Million Loans to Create New Jobs, 1966](https://aei.pitt.edu/100021): 1966 ECSC press release on regional development employment loans
- [Freedom or Joy; or Both? German Unification Speech by Leon Brittan, 1990](https://aei.pitt.edu/100098): 1990 Leon Brittan speech on German unification and European integration
- [The Changing European Map - Bruce Millan at Eurocities Conference, 1990](https://aei.pitt.edu/100103): 1990 Bruce Millan speech at Eurocities Conference in Lyon

## EU Institutional Development and Governance

- [Foreign Affairs Committee - Intergovernmental Conference Minutes, 1996](https://aei.pitt.edu/100013): 1996 Foreign Affairs Committee minutes on EU treaty reform
- [List of EC Agreements with Third Countries, 1979](https://aei.pitt.edu/100057): 1979 EC list of international agreements with third countries
- [SIGMA: Bulletin of European Statistics No 2 2001](https://aei.pitt.edu/100060): 2001 SIGMA bulletin on CEIES European statistical policy

- [XIII Magazine News Review Issue 1/1992](https://aei.pitt.edu/100111): 1992 XIII Magazine news review on information services market
- [XIII Magazine News Review Issue 2/1992](https://aei.pitt.edu/100112): 1992 XIII Magazine news review on information society developments
